title: Effort tiers may not reach GLM: pi records thinkingLevel high whatever effort the profile asks
description: Found during jd3 (2026-10-04): on this machine both `--model cloudflare-workers-ai/@cf/zai-org/glm-5.3-flash:medium` and `--thinking medium` recorded thinkingLevel: high in the pi session, on pi 0.85.1 and 1.0.2. ticfac's tier cells set effort (economy medium, strong high), so the economy rung may be running at high effort (cost/latency) or the setting is ignored by the model/provider. Verify what Workers AI's GLM 5.3 / Flash accept (reasoning effort / thinking params via the gateway), whether pi maps effort to them, and fix the mapping (for pi-durable in 43y's gateway provider, oq4) or drop effort from cells that cannot honour it.
acceptance_criteria: A recorded check per model (requested effort → what reached the provider → observed behaviour); the cells/provider fixed or the effort field removed where it has no effect; tests.
